style_prefix: Painterly speculative-ecology storybook, restrained gouache and ink, readable alien anatomy, low blue bioluminescence and muted amber living-road light, warm domestic observation, quiet moral pressure, purely pictorial composition.

prompts.prompt: Wide crescent nursery packing hollow under thick living roots: low oval pale-ribbed work cradle in the center, small nest alcoves left, clear mineral basin right, leaf-skin archive pockets, cold blue hanging light knots, and a shallow central ramp rising to two rows of amber fungal candles.

Four long horizontal alien hexapods around a low packing cradle: rust-brown caretaker fitting a flank frame, small tawny juvenile sorting route cords, older slate-gray caretaker spreading flexible archive membranes, dark ochre repair-kin wrestling a shelter roll; a pale green hand-sized mobile flower grips the juvenile's bare left flank.

Close care-work still life with alien chest manipulators: unfinished lit flower sling, mineral brush, violet-edged archive membranes, route cords, three shallow mineral spoons, clear basin, and a pale green burden flower attached to a young six-limbed traveler.

Warm ordinary packing in a root-lit nursery hollow: rust-brown and dark ochre adult alien hexapods share flower-care work while a tawny juvenile watches, an older slate-gray caretaker records the transfer, and cold blue lantern knots meet patient amber road candles.

Pivotal close frame: crouched tawny juvenile alien hexapod with facial sensing fans shut; a hand-sized pale green flower clamps to the bare flank and blooms yellow, violet, and red; older caretaker freezes a mineral brush under one rootlet while two adults hold still; blue root lights flash white and amber road candles narrow up the ramp.

Care decision geometry around a low oval cradle: rust-brown adult alien hexapod between a crouched juvenile and the route ramp, older caretaker beside open archive membranes, clear mineral basin on the right, red-bloomed mobile flower on the child's flank, narrow amber fungal candles visible uphill.

Wide nursery route threshold: crescent stone hollow, central work cradle and family frame, nest alcoves left, mineral basin right, shallow ramp to amber fungal road; four long-bodied alien hexapods and one hand-sized plant companion wait under cold blue roots as returning daylight reaches the ramp.

Follow view up a shallow ramp: rust-brown adult alien hexapod carries a balanced care frame beside a tawny juvenile, dark ochre repair-kin follows with second load, pale green plant companion rides on child or lit mineral sling, central violet care archive visible between adult reach, amber living road ahead.

Amber fungal road divides across dark mineral ground: bright main lane for dark ochre trade-carrier, slower blue-lit grove lane for rust-brown caretaker, tawny juvenile, and pale green plant companion; matching violet archive strips make one family obligation visible across two routes.

Long sightline from clear mineral basin to nursery ramp: pale green mobile flower rests under blue root lights beside older slate-gray caretaker; tawny juvenile looks back from the ramp beside rust-brown adult; matching route-cord loops join basin rim and family frame across the central cradle.

Safe crowded packing hollow after the amber road closes: rust-brown adult lowers family frame, tawny juvenile rests beside pale green flower, older slate-gray caretaker reopens archive membranes, dark ochre repair-kin sorts route-debt cords and three mineral spoons under returning light and cold blue roots.
